Budget.description: Hard caps (run ceiling <= $1000). Admission rules in budget.py; calls that would exceed are refused. Effective retries = min(maxRetriesPerCall, role caps.maxRetries); repairs <= 1; each is a new admission.

stageCeilingsSec.description: Optional per-stage ceilings in seconds (synchronous stages only; LEARN is async). A listed stage replaces its legacy table ceiling, an unlisted one keeps it; absent = legacy.

x-invariants: budget-order: soft <= hard deadline; per-agent <= total
stage-ceilings: stageCeilingsSec is non-empty and each ceiling <= wallClockSec

CaseInput.description: Everything the reviewer may see. Closed object: labels, fix commits and expectations cannot be added here.

repo.description: GitHub 'Owner/Name' with display case preserved (identity is case-folded, canonical.repo_key), or an opaque lowercase slug for synthetic/local fixtures.

CaseLabels.description: Scorer-only. Must live under the suite's labels/ directory.

Comment.description: Local/eval PUBLISH writes state=draft (read-only reviews never post). severity <= severityCeiling; proposedSeverity vs severity shows any cap. suggestion is explanatory text for the author; it is never applied. qualityScore null = not scored (no quality model in Stage 0A).
x-invariants: comment-state: state fields, anchor, id derivation, severity bounds

ContextRequest.description: Data, never authority: any grammatical tool name or argument key is schema-valid and the host ToolSession alone decides what runs (unknown tools/args/values become a logged denied ToolResult shown to the model). purpose never reaches a tool and never changes policy, caps or tools.

CostRecord.description: Eval executions are ReviewRuns booked as kind=eval (amends 14). Replayed records repeat recorded values and are never summed as new spend. Ids are unique per run only; aggregate by (runId, id). overrun=true when actual > reservation.
x-invariants: cost-attribution: kind/basis attribution and id derivation
no-secrets: persisted DropRecord contains no protected text (redact first)

EvalReport.description: Micro-averaged P/R. Matching path-line-overlap@1 (synthetic smoke only): duplicates count as false positives and are also reported separately; F1 is null if P or R is null and 0 if P+R=0. Real-PR datasets are unscored (unadjudicated@1): metrics null with reason. Never a parity claim.

x-invariants: derived-defined: value xor reason
report-honesty: tallies, F1, coverage, matching scope and replay cost accounting recompute from the cases
no-secrets: persisted EvalReport contains no protected text (redact first)

Evidence.description: Pipeline-built evidence. Non-code kinds are copied from trusted tool.call results (severity.materialize_evidence), never taken from model output. resolved=true is set only by the pipeline/tool layer after the citation was checked against the pinned snapshot (snapshot.snapshot_resolver); code evidence without it is untrusted. ModelEvidence cannot carry it.
x-invariants: evidence-shape: code needs path+lines+commit; others need toolCallId
no-secrets: persisted Evidence contains no protected text (redact first)

EvidenceStrength.description: Evidence confidence derived from trusted traces (severity.evidence_strength), separate from impact and severity. Used for ranking, never minted by a model.

Finding.description: Finding.id equals the Hypothesis id it came from: hypothesis_id(specialist, index, claim, location.path, location.line) of entry `index` in the output of sourceCallId, the INVESTIGATE investigator call that proposed it. verification.callIds are the distinct VERIFY verifier calls whose request names this id (ModelRequest.hypothesisId) and which confirmed it; severityBasis and verification.evidence are what those calls returned (check_finding_provenance). The verifier may cite the same pinned lines as the proposer.
x-invariants: independent-confirm: verifier calls are distinct from the proposer call; code evidence is snapshot-resolved

InvestigatorOutput.description: Investigator role output schema. Empty list = nothing found.

ModelRequest.description: Redacted before hashing; requestHash = canonical.request_hash(request). Closed and typed: no field carries a run/eval id or timestamp, and prompt text is built from content-addressed inputs only (D6: host metadata is kept out by construction, a leak makes strict replay miss; repository text is never filtered). hypothesisId names the hypothesis a verifier request checks; a verifier call without it cannot confirm a Finding. Turn requests carry hop (0..15), continuationOf (callId of the previous hop's accepted attempt, hop > 0) and contextResults (toolCallIds shown, in order: host-prepared context at hop 0, one per previous-hop contextRequest after). All are covered by requestHash; check_turn_trace states the chain rules. Legacy requests omit them.
x-invariants: request-subject: hypothesisId only on verifier requests
request-turn: hop iff Turn schema; continuationOf iff hop > 0; contextResults only on Turn requests, required when hop > 0
no-secrets: persisted ModelRequest contains no protected text (redact first)
ok-has-output: ok => output
no-secrets: persisted ModelResponse contains no protected text (redact first)

ReviewRun.description: id = run_id(idempotencyKey, attempt). Duplicate host events return the existing run; resume keeps the id; manual rerun = same key, attempt+1. access is always read-only: no target writes, no target execution, no posting.

repo.description: GitHub 'Owner/Name' with display case preserved (identity is case-folded, canonical.repo_key), or an opaque lowercase slug for synthetic/local fixtures.

ScoreDedup.description: Groups of 0-based candidate indices judged duplicates. Partition checks are local.

ScoreExtraction.description: LEGACY copy shape (bench.extract@v1/v2); not legal for any score role. Candidate findings extracted from one tool's review. text is required data and is kept exactly as supplied, including whitespace-only non-empty strings.

ScoreExtractionSegments.description: Candidate findings of one tool's review BY REFERENCE (bench.extract@v3): each names a source comment id and the inclusive 1-based range startSegment..endSegment of that comment's numbered segments. No model-written text. Order (start <= end), the upper bound (<= segment count) and the id lookup are local producer checks against the trusted segmentation, so they classify as extraction-invalid.

ScorePair.description: One gold/candidate judgment; confidence is a finite number, not clamped.

ScoreProfile.description: Immutable; referenced as '<id>@<version>'. Exactly the three score roles, one model, zero retries/repairs, priced, no fallbacks. Not a ModelProfile: it cannot be used for review.

Distinct from ModelRequest, which it never validates as, and vice versa.

ScoreRun.description: id is run_<16 hex> (so CostRecord.runId fits) but derived by canonical.score_run_id, never run_id. inputDigest digests the external store's rendered inputs, never text. A strict replay uses a fresh evalRunId, hence a different id, with replayOf pinned. No repo, snapshot, trigger, PR or prompt fields.

items.description: investigator.impact@v3 only: hypotheses of later specialists that duplicate keptId (same head path and category, start lines within 3). They stay in `hypotheses`; VERIFY verifies the first one only when keptId yields no finding and drops the others as merged.

matching.description: path-line-overlap@1 is SYNTHETIC SMOKE ONLY: it ignores the claim and its grade. Real PR datasets use unadjudicated@1 until a human-adjudicated rule exists.

SweepCoverage.description: investigator.impact@v4 only: the deterministic diff-shard partition of the reviewable changed files and, per swept file, the disposition its sweep investigator gave: issue (a resolved hypothesis of that sweep agent located in the file), no-issue (a logged file_disposition record of that agent, with its reason and toolCallId) or uncovered (neither, after the one bounded continuation). Changed files the partition left out are listed with the reason (deleted, generated, no text diff, shard limit). outOfShardDropped counts sweep hypotheses located outside the reporting sweep's own shard, which are not kept (VERIFY drops them as suppressed).

description: Generated from reviewer/contracts/entities.py; do not edit by hand. The Python validator is authoritative and stricter than this bundle: (1) x-invariants (cross-field rules) are enforced only in Python; (2) Python rejects integer-valued floats such as 1.0 where JSON Schema 'integer' accepts them; (3) nesting depth (64), node/size limits, duplicate keys and lone surrogates cannot be expressed here; use reviewer.contracts.loads_strict; (4) every pattern uses the Python/ECMA-262 common subset ([0-9], no \d) and is anchored with ^(?:...)$, while Python uses fullmatch. Canonical hashes are recomputed only by Python (see canonical.py).
